summary.text: Gale Adcock is a Democratic member of the North Carolina State Senate who has represented District 16 since January 1, 2023, and is on the ballot for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She previously served in the North Carolina House of Representatives, District 41, from 2015 to 2023, and Ballotpedia lists her profession as nurse practitioner.

paragraphs.text: Adcock grew up in Virginia and lives in Cary, North Carolina.

She earned a nursing diploma from Virginia Baptist Hospital, a bachelor's degree in nursing from East Carolina University in 1978, and a graduate degree in nursing from the University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill in 1987.
Ballotpedia lists her career experience as working as a nurse practitioner and as chief health officer at SAS Institute.
Adcock served as president of the North Carolina Nurses Association and chair of the North Carolina Center for Nursing, and she became a member of the North Carolina Board of Nursing.
Adcock succeeded Wiley Nickel, a fellow Democrat, in the Senate.

For the 2025-2026 session, Ballotpedia lists her as a member of the Appropriations on Health and Human Services, Commerce and Insurance, Finance, Rules and Operations of the Senate, Health Care, and State and Local Government committees.
